frequencyResponse.pointsContext: Exact-model Dynaudio Core 7 2022 specification sheet, table titled ANSI/CEA-2034-A Directivity Response. Ten on-axis SPL values from 20 Hz through 20 kHz are transcribed verbatim; no interpolation or smoothing. The table labels SPL as referenced to 1 m but does not state input/drive level. The simulator therefore uses these published points only as curve shape, normalised at 1 kHz; they are not an acoustic sensitivity rating. The current product page separately specifies its 40 Hz–27 kHz cutoffs at 85 dB +/- 3 dB; the 2022 sheet lists 45 Hz–27 kHz +/- 3 dB and 38 Hz–31 kHz +/- 6 dB. These contexts are kept distinct rather than blended.

notes: Dynaudio's exact current Core 7 product page identifies a two-way DSP nearfield monitor with a 7-inch MSP mid/woofer and reports a 500 W LF/mid-woofer amplifier plus a 150 W HF amplifier. Its response cutoffs are 40 Hz and 27 kHz at 85 dB +/- 3 dB; the dynamic -6 dB cutoffs are 36 Hz and 29 kHz. The 2022 spec sheet separately gives 45 Hz–27 kHz +/- 3 dB and 38 Hz–31 kHz +/- 6 dB; the structured range stores only the current page's 85 dB cutoffs, and the separately sourced response points retain their own context. The split amplifier ratings are not collapsed or summed into the single power field, which remains N/A. Maximum SPL (112 dB anechoic / 118 dB half-space) is not sensitivity; passive impedance and acoustic sensitivity remain unavailable. No polar/directivity payload is imported.
